about: The closing cards (brief, End card and fact cards; M5). Card G and the fact rows are copied word for word from the Default On song doc (https://claude.ai/artifact/CZ4NPoVgNhxTUwRisQ9JBP, rev 58; the M8 fixes, 2026-11-10): card G from its 'Who wrote this?' draft, the rows from its fact card table, in table order. The disclosure is the human's wording (brief, 2026-11-09). The end card follows the brief's End card line, and a second credits card (Sound) carries the human's sound credits (2026-11-09); `interventions` is filled in by scripts/timing_map.py from log/human_interventions.md. Each card's length comes from its word count (scripts/timing_map.py).

G.heading: Who wrote this?
G.body: Claude, an AI model made by Anthropic, drafted the lyrics. In August 2025, Anthropic asked existing consumer users to accept new terms in a pop-up whose toggle for training on their chats was set to On by default. The human creator chose, edited and fact-checked everything in this video. Gemini and ChatGPT audited it; their findings and the fixes are logged.

D.body: Made by a former Google and Microsoft employee, who holds no stock in either. Nothing here comes from the inside: every claim is from public reporting, sourced on the cards that follow.

rows.lyric: Answer box on top; tiny "Web" tab
rows.body: Google's AI Overviews rolled out broadly from I/O 2024. Google's help page calls them a core Search feature that can't be turned off. The "Web" filter shows plain results.

rows.lyric: Inbox helper flipped on last fall
rows.body: Thele v. Google alleges Gemini-powered smart features were switched on by default for Gmail, Chat and Meet from about October 10, 2025. Google says it changed no settings and doesn't train Gemini on Gmail content.
rows.status: Alleged. Dismissed for lack of standing July 7, 2026, with leave to amend; refiled August 18; Google's new motion to dismiss pending

rows.body: Turning off Gmail's smart features takes two separate settings, with three switches between them.

rows.lyric: TV tile you can hide but not delete
rows.body: A December 2025 LG webOS update added a Copilot shortcut that could only be hidden. LG said it would let owners delete it in a future update. Microsoft says Copilot leaves LG and Samsung TVs on December 1, 2026.

rows.lyric: Blue ring in the chat app; mute, not uninstall
rows.body: Meta AI in WhatsApp, Facebook and Instagram can't be disabled; the chat can be muted.

iOS 18.3.2 (March 2025) turned Apple Intelligence back on for some users who had disabled it, after a splash screen with only a Continue button. Not every device was affected; John Gruber suspected a bug.

rows.lyric: Forty-five percent; cheap plan only on leaving
rows.body: The ACCC alleges Microsoft misled about 2.7 million Australians: the Personal plan rose 45% to A$159 and the Family plan 29% to A$179 with Copilot, and the Classic plan was offered only during cancellation.
rows.status: Alleged; case before the Federal Court

rows.body: Google's VP for education told The New York Times that students at schools rejecting its AI would lose Search.

Google then said schools can turn Gemini off and keep Search, but AI Overviews and AI Mode can't be removed from Search. Changes begin in early 2027. On Nov. 3, 2026, Google's VP for education, Chris Phillips, had told The New York Times that Search and AI are "deeply integrated," so students at schools that reject its AI "will not have access to search." Context: in August 2026 Google had switched Gemini on by default for many K-12 student accounts; in October, Senators Blumenthal and Hawley asked Google why it makes AI the default in schools.
